question.text: Investor starts with Rs. 1 crore target 60/40. After a year equity grew 20% to Rs. 72 lakh, debt grew 7% to Rs. 42.8 lakh. Equity weight now:

explanation.text: The Logic: Total = 72 + 42.8 = 114.8; equity weight = 72/114.8 = 62.7%. The Trap: 60% ignores drift, 65% overstates. Cross-Exam Context: Drift arithmetic. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Use 60-day equity weight trend in reviews to flag drift early.
